product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage provides an AI-powered financial-crime compliance platform that helps financial institutions and other businesses screen customers, monitor transactions, and detect money-laundering and sanctions risks.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 474 employees; LinkedIn also lists the company-size band as 201–500.

eng_blog.notes: Both posts are by Principal Software Engineer Mark Allanson and discuss production architecture, infrastructure, or implementation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The 2026-11-09 snapshot lists 16 open positions and none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Founding GTM Engineer involves applied AI but does not qualify under the requested title-based definition.

model_provider.notes: Resistant AI supplies the optional product add-on for alert prioritization, advanced fraud/AML detection, and rule optimization; this does not establish the provider of Mesh’s generative-AI models.

compliance_certs.notes: The same page claims GDPR alignment, not a GDPR certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest fully specified financing found is a $16.8 million debt round dated 2025-05-19 in PitchBook. A later report calls a December 2025 share allotment a £23.1k funding round, but its stage and USD proceeds could not be verified; the filing index confirms an allotment, not its funding-round classification. The most recent round therefore cannot be stated confidently.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook dates a $16.8 million debt financing to 2025-05-19, within the 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 window. The filing history additionally records a 2025-12-19 share allotment, reported as new funding in May 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced real-time Payment Screening integration into Mesh on 2026-05-19, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Rhiannon Prothero announced joining as Global Vice President, Marketing, on 2026-06-05.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Founding GTM Engineer posting names all four as the stack to integrate and calls Salesforce the system of record.
